stemMd: A diploid cell has 8 pg of nuclear DNA immediately after mitosis. Ignoring mutations and cell death, how much nuclear DNA does it contain after the next S phase but before mitosis?
explanationMd: S phase duplicates each nuclear DNA molecule once. DNA mass doubles from 8 to 16 pg even though chromosome number counted by centromeres is unchanged before chromatid separation.

distractorRationale.a: This ignores replication during S phase.
distractorRationale.b: DNA is copied, not halved, during S phase.
distractorRationale.e: Replication adds one copy rather than two additional copies.
distractorRationale.d: This would require two successive rounds of replication without division.
